sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 在2011年，加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，并且体内的血液已被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈献”的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Four-year-old Sherry Pepini knew the lyrics to everything by pop singer Michael Bublé well.
sentences.zh: 四岁的雪莉·佩皮尼对流行歌手迈克尔·布雷的歌曲《Everything》的歌词了如指掌。

sentences.en: Not only had she chosen it as her wedding song when marrying the love of her life, Keith, it was also a great pacekeeper when exercising.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是她与一生挚爱基思结婚时的婚礼曲目，也是她锻炼时的绝佳配速伴侣。

sentences.en: In November 2016, the Californian mother of two had almost fully healed from a recent breast augmentation procedure.
sentences.zh: 2016年11月，这位育有两子的加州母亲刚做完隆胸手术不久，身体几乎完全康复。

sentences.en: Finally feeling well enough to start jogging again, Sherry had started training for an upcoming 5K race.
sentences.zh: 雪莉终于觉得自己状态足够好，可以重新开始慢跑，并开始为即将到来的5公里赛跑进行训练。

sentences.en: Still a bit rusty, she was using an app to track her progress.
sentences.zh: 由于还有些生疏，她正在使用一款应用程序来记录自己的进展。

sentences.en: Wednesday, November 2 was a clear day.
sentences.zh: 11月2日，星期三，天气晴朗。

sentences.en: With her two young children in daycare and her husband at work,
sentences.zh: 两个年幼的孩子在日托中心，丈夫在上班，

sentences.en: Sherry got dressed in black leggings, a pink Nike hoodie, and checkered tennis shoes.
sentences.zh: 雪莉穿上黑色紧身裤、粉色耐克连帽衫和格子网球鞋。

sentences.en: She headed outside.
sentences.zh: 她出门了。

sentences.en: The Pepini family lived in Redding, a small city in Northern California.
sentences.zh: 佩皮尼一家住在北加州小城雷丁。

sentences.en: Their home in the rural Mountain Gate area was surrounded by flat, tree-lined roads and wide-open spaces that provided a pleasant backdrop for a run.
sentences.zh: 他们在乡村山门地区的家被平坦、绿树成荫的道路和开阔的空间所环绕，为跑步提供了宜人的背景。

sentences.en: Sherry connected her earbuds to her iPhone and opened her fitness app.
sentences.zh: 雪莉将耳机连接到iPhone上，并打开了健身应用。

sentences.en: She pressed play on her wedding song and started jogging down her driveway.
sentences.zh: 她按下播放键播放了婚礼歌曲，开始沿着车道慢跑。

sentences.en: Later that evening, an emergency services operator received a call from Sherry's husband, Keith Pepini.
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚晚些时候，紧急服务接线员接到雪莉的丈夫基思·佩皮尼的电话。

sentences.en: He'd just returned home from work and said he was freaking out because his wife wasn't there.
sentences.zh: 他刚下班回家，说自己吓坏了，因为妻子不在家。

sentences.en: Officers from the Shasta County Sheriff's Office quickly arrived at the couple's home.
sentences.zh: 沙斯塔县警长办公室的警员迅速赶到了这对夫妇的家中。

sentences.en: Keith explained that it was just after 5pm when he pulled into the driveway of his family's two-storey home.
sentences.zh: 基思解释说，他把车开进自家两层楼的住宅车道时，时间刚过下午5点。

sentences.en: It was the same house that Keith himself had been raised in.
sentences.zh: 这正是基思本人从小长大的那栋房子。

sentences.en: With its sprawling backyard, leafy surrounds, and a basketball ring in the driveway, it was the ideal place to raise a family.
sentences.zh: 这里有宽敞的后院、绿树成荫的环境以及车道上的篮球架，是养育家庭的理想场所。

sentences.en: Keith approached the front door, prepared for the usual warm welcome from his boisterous four-year-old son and two-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 基思走近前门，准备迎接他那精力充沛的四岁儿子和两岁女儿惯常的热情欢迎。

sentences.en: But as he stepped inside, it was oddly quiet.
sentences.zh: 但当他走进去时，里面出奇地安静。

sentences.en: Sherry Pepini typically kept the family on a tight schedule and always let her husband know if anything unexpected had arisen.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·佩皮尼通常把家里的作息安排得井井有条，如果有任何突发情况，总是会通知丈夫。

sentences.en: But Keith said the last he'd heard from Sherry was around 11am when she texted asking if he was going to be home for lunch.
sentences.zh: 但基思说，他最后一次听到雪莉的消息是在上午11点左右，当时她发短信问他是否回家吃午饭。

sentences.en: It had been a busy day for Keith, who worked at a Best Buy electronics store, and he'd responded that he wouldn't be able to make it.
sentences.zh: 在百思买电子产品商店工作的基思那天很忙，他回复说自己赶不回去。

sentences.en: Keith walked through their home.
sentences.zh: 基思在家里走了一圈。

sentences.en: Everything appeared as normal except for a half-wrapped present addressed to him from Sherry and the kids.
sentences.zh: 一切看起来都很正常，除了一个只包了一半的礼物，上面写着是雪莉和孩子们送给他的。

sentences.en: Inside was a handmade American flag pillow.
sentences.zh: 里面是一个手工制作的美国国旗抱枕。

sentences.en: Keith looked outside.
sentences.zh: 基思向外看去。

sentences.en: Sherry's car was in the driveway, but there was no sign of her or the kids anyway.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的车停在车道上，但无论如何都找不到她或孩子们的踪影。

sentences.en: He sent Sherry a text, but there was no response.
sentences.zh: 他给雪莉发了短信，但没有回复。

sentences.en: He called the children's daycare provider and asked what time Sherry had stopped by.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给孩子们的日托中心，询问雪莉是什么时候把孩子接走的。

sentences.en: The daycare worker was taken aback.
sentences.zh: 日托中心的工作人员大吃一惊。

sentences.en: Sherry hadn't picked the kids up.
sentences.zh: 雪莉并没有接走孩子们。

sentences.en: They were still there.
sentences.zh: 他们还在那里。

sentences.en: Keith's initial confusion quickly turned to concern.
sentences.zh: 基思最初的困惑迅速转化为担忧。

sentences.en: He logged in to his Find My iPhone app, which was also configured to recognise the location of his wife.
sentences.zh: 他登录了“查找我的iPhone”应用，该应用也配置为识别他妻子的位置。

sentences.en: The icon confirmed that Sherry's phone was located less than one mile away, at the corner of Old Oregon Trail and Sunrise Drive.
sentences.zh: 图标显示雪莉的手机就在不到一英里外的老俄勒冈小径与日出大道交叉口。

sentences.en: Thinking Sherry might have gone for a walk, Keith drove to the specified location.
sentences.zh: 基思以为雪莉可能是去散步了，便开车去了指定地点。

sentences.en: There was no one there.
sentences.zh: 那里一个人也没有。

sentences.en: He called his mother to see if she had spoken to Sherry.
sentences.zh: 他打电话给母亲，看她是否和雪莉说过话。

sentences.en: She hadn't.
sentences.zh: 她没有。

sentences.en: Keith tried to remain calm.
sentences.zh: 基思努力保持镇定。

sentences.en: He told himself that Sherry might have accidentally left her phone on the roof of her car and it had fallen off during the drive.
sentences.zh: 他告诉自己，雪莉可能不小心把手机放在了车顶上，开车时掉落了。

sentences.en: But that didn't explain why she hadn't picked up the kids.
sentences.zh: 但这并不能解释她为什么没有去接孩子们。

sentences.en: Sherry was an incredibly dedicated mother who doted on her children and it was completely out of character for her to leave them in daycare this late.
sentences.zh: 雪莉是一位极其奉献的母亲，对孩子们百般疼爱，把他们留在日托中心这么晚完全不符合她的性格。

sentences.en: Nor did she have any health conditions that could explain a sudden absence.
sentences.zh: 她也没有任何可以解释突然失踪的健康状况。

sentences.en: Keith got out of the car and started looking around.
sentences.zh: 基思下车开始四处张望。

sentences.en: The intersection housed all the letterboxes for the neighbourhood and it was just one and a half miles from the nearest highway.
sentences.zh: 这个十字路口汇集了附近所有的邮箱，距离最近的高速公路只有一英里半。

sentences.en: Other than that, it was fairly remote.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，这里相当偏远。

sentences.en: No houses were in the immediate vicinity and traffic wasn't busy.
sentences.zh: 附近没有房屋，交通也不繁忙。

sentences.en: Just off the road, Keith found Sherry's iPhone in the grass.
sentences.zh: 就在路边，基思在草丛中找到了雪莉的iPhone。

sentences.en: It had a crack on the front screen but was still functioning.
sentences.zh: 它的前屏有裂纹，但仍能正常使用。

sentences.en: Sherry's headphones were still connected and Michael Bublé's Everything was playing on repeat.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的耳机还连着，迈克尔·布雷的《Everything》正在单曲循环。

sentences.en: Wrapped around the headphones were several strands of long blonde hair.
sentences.zh: 耳机上缠绕着几缕长金发。

sentences.en: The same colour and length as Sherry's.
sentences.zh: 颜色和长度与雪莉的头发一模一样。

sentences.en: Officers visited the location where Sherry's phone was found.
sentences.zh: 警员们走访了发现雪莉手机的地点。

sentences.en: They found no signs that a struggle had taken place.
sentences.zh: 他们没有发现发生过搏斗的迹象。

sentences.en: Similarly, a search of the Pepini's home revealed that everything was in order and nothing appeared to have been stolen.
sentences.zh: 同样，对佩皮尼一家的搜查显示一切正常，没有什么东西被偷。

sentences.en: But there was no evidence to support the possibility that Sherry had taken off voluntarily.
sentences.zh: 但没有证据支持雪莉是自愿出走的可能性。

sentences.en: Her purse and belongings were all accounted for and she hadn't made any significant withdrawals from her bank account.
sentences.zh: 她的钱包和随身物品都在，而且她的银行账户也没有进行过大额取款。

sentences.en: Police questioned whether Sherry could have run away to start afresh elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 警方质疑雪莉是否可能是离家出走去别处重新开始。

sentences.en: Keith vehemently denied this possibility.
sentences.zh: 基思强烈否认了这种可能性。

sentences.en: He had known Sherry since middle school.
sentences.zh: 他从初中起就认识雪莉了。

sentences.en: The two had shared a kiss as teenagers but it wasn't until years later that they reconnected and a romance blossomed.
sentences.zh: 两人在青少年时期曾共享一个吻，但直到多年后他们重新联系上，恋情才萌芽。

sentences.en: Keith was immediately smitten with Sherry, a bubbly, blue-eyed blonde with a luminous smile.
sentences.zh: 基思对雪莉一见钟情，她是一个活泼、蓝眼睛、金发、笑容灿烂的女孩。

sentences.en: They married in 2009 and Sherry soon left her job as a telecommunications account executive to be a stay-at-home mum.
sentences.zh: 他们于2009年结婚，雪莉不久后辞去了电信客户主管的工作，成为了一名全职妈妈。

sentences.en: It was a position she thrived in.
sentences.zh: 这是一个她做得风生水起的角色。

sentences.en: Sherry organised all kinds of projects and activities for her children while also being a doting wife and homemaker.
sentences.zh: 雪莉为孩子们组织了各种各样的项目和活动，同时也是一个慈爱的妻子和家庭主妇。

sentences.en: She put great care and attention into everything she did, be it decorating a homemade pie, planning a birthday party for her children, or maintaining her physical appearance.
sentences.zh: 她对自己做的每一件事都倾注了极大的关爱和关注，无论是装饰自制派、为孩子策划生日派对，还是保持外表。

sentences.en: According to Keith, the couple had a very happy marriage.
sentences.zh: 据基思说，这对夫妇的婚姻非常幸福。

sentences.en: They fought occasionally, but no more than any other couple.
sentences.zh: 他们偶尔会吵架，但并不比其他夫妻多。

sentences.en: Their last argument had been a month prior over something as trivial as a messy room.
sentences.zh: 他们上一次争吵是一个月前，因为房间凌乱这样的小事。

sentences.en: Keith said there was no way that Sherry would ever voluntarily leave her children.
sentences.zh: 基思说雪莉绝不可能自愿离开她的孩子们。

sentences.en: It was a sentiment shared by others who described Sherry Pepini as a super mum.
sentences.zh: 其他将雪莉·佩皮尼描述为超级妈妈的人也有同感。

sentences.en: In the lead-up to her disappearance, everything had been completely normal.
sentences.zh: 在她失踪前夕，一切都完全正常。

sentences.en: Sherry had given no indication that she was making plans to leave or wanted to escape her responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 雪莉没有表现出任何她正在计划离开或想要逃避责任的迹象。

sentences.en: She had recently taken her children out trick-or-treating for Halloween and was already planning what to cook for an upcoming Thanksgiving dinner.
sentences.zh: 她最近刚带孩子们出去过万圣节不给糖就捣蛋，已经在计划即将到来的感恩节晚宴做什么菜了。

sentences.en: A background check revealed no known history of domestic abuse or any police call-outs to the Pepini's property.
sentences.zh: 背景调查显示，没有已知的家庭暴力历史，也没有警察接到报警前往佩皮尼家。

sentences.en: In fact, Keith's record was squeaky clean.
sentences.zh: 事实上，基思的记录一尘不染。

sentences.en: Still, police had to consider the possibility that Keith was involved with his wife's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方不得不考虑基思与他妻子的失踪有关的可能性。

sentences.en: What if he had killed her and then staged a kidnapping to deflect attention from himself?
sentences.zh: 如果他杀害了她，然后策划了一起绑架案来转移人们对自己的注意力呢？

sentences.en: Police looked into Keith's movements from Wednesday November 2 and confirmed that he was at work all day.
sentences.zh: 警方调查了基思在11月2日星期三的行踪，证实他一整天都在上班。

sentences.en: The last reported sighting of Sherry Pepini occurred around 2pm when a neighbour saw her jogging.
sentences.zh: 最后一次接到目击雪莉·佩皮尼的报告是在下午2点左右，当时一位邻居看到她在慢跑。

sentences.en: There had been no suspicious vehicles sighted in the area nor had anyone heard cries for help.
sentences.zh: 该地区没有发现可疑车辆，也没有人听到呼救声。

sentences.en: Sherry was considered to be an alert-aware person.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被认为是一个警觉的人。

sentences.en: Had someone approached her,
sentences.zh: 如果有人接近她，

sentences.en: Sherry's loved ones believed she would have put up a fight.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的亲人相信她会进行反抗。

sentences.en: It therefore seemed more likely that whoever took her had snuck up unsuspectingly.
sentences.zh: 因此，绑架她的人似乎更有可能是悄悄摸近的。

sentences.en: Either that or more than one person was involved.
sentences.zh: 要么就是不止一个人作案。

sentences.en: A team searched overnight, covering a half-mile radius from the corner of Old Oregon Trail and Sunrise Drive where Sherry's phone was found.
sentences.zh: 搜救队彻夜搜查，覆盖了发现雪莉手机的老俄勒冈小径与日出大道交汇处周围半英里的半径。

sentences.en: An aerial search was also conducted, but nothing of interest was found.
sentences.zh: 还进行了空中搜寻，但没有发现任何有价值的线索。

sentences.en: The discarded iPhone was the only clue police had to go by.
sentences.zh: 被丢弃的iPhone是警方仅有的线索。

sentences.en: The following day, Sherry's sister-in-law Suzanne discussed its significance in the press, saying that while it was good to have some sort of clue,
sentences.zh: 第二天，雪莉的嫂子苏珊在媒体上讨论了它的重要性，称虽然有某种线索是件好事，

sentences.en: it indicated that Sherry had been taken.
sentences.zh: 但这表明雪莉是被绑架了。

sentences.en: Suzanne said,
sentences.zh: 苏珊说，

sentences.en: She wouldn't just drop her phone if she was running away.
sentences.zh: 如果她是逃跑，她不会无缘无故扔掉手机。

sentences.en: At least it's giving us some kind of information, but we're sick.
sentences.zh: 至少这给我们提供了一些信息，但我们快吐了。

sentences.en: This is a pretty sickening situation.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当令人作呕的情况。

sentences.en: The Reading community was in shock.
sentences.zh: 雷丁社区陷入震惊。

sentences.en: Sherry had no known enemies.
sentences.zh: 雪莉没有已知的仇人。

sentences.en: Keith Pepini said there had been no strange activity such as suspicious calls or emails in the lead-up to his wife's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 基思·佩皮尼表示，在他妻子失踪前夕，没有发生过可疑电话或电子邮件等奇怪活动。

sentences.en: So who would abduct an innocent mother of two so brazenly in broad daylight just one mile from her home?
sentences.zh: 那么，究竟是谁在距离她家仅一英里的光天化日之下，如此肆无忌惮地绑架了一位无辜的两个孩子的母亲呢？

sentences.en: The Mountain Gate area was considered a safe place to live, but like any other town,
sentences.zh: 山门地区被认为是一个居住的安全地方，但和任何其他城镇一样，

sentences.en: Reading had skeletons in its closet.
sentences.zh: 雷丁也有不可告人的秘密。

sentences.en: Back in August 1998,
sentences.zh: 早在1998年8月，

sentences.en: 16-year-old Tara Smith set out for a jog down Old Oregon Trail and was never seen again.
sentences.zh: 16岁的塔拉·史密斯出发去老俄勒冈小径慢跑，之后就再也没有露面。

sentences.en: While Tara's case remained unsolved, the people of Reading had never forgotten it.
sentences.zh: 虽然塔拉的案件至今未破，但雷丁的人民从未忘记它。

sentences.en: Some were quick to point out an eerie coincidence.
sentences.zh: 一些人很快指出这是一种诡异的巧合。

sentences.en: Tara Smith and Sherry Pepini had attended the same high school at the same time.
sentences.zh: 塔拉·史密斯和雪莉·佩皮尼曾在同一时间就读于同一所高中。

sentences.en: They also shared a similar look, with some noting they could easily pass for sisters.
sentences.zh: 她们的外貌也很相似，有人指出她们完全可以假乱真成姐妹。

sentences.en: Although the pair weren't known to be friends, and despite 18 years passing between the two disappearances, it did spark some questions.
sentences.zh: 虽然这对夫妇不以朋友身份为人所知，且两次失踪之间隔了18年，但这确实引发了一些疑问。

sentences.en: Was it possible the same perpetrator had struck again?
sentences.zh: 会不会是同一个凶手再次作案？

sentences.en: Four known sex offenders lived within one mile of the location where Sherry's phone was found.
sentences.zh: 有四名已知的性犯罪者住在发现雪莉手机地点的一英里内。

sentences.en: Fifty more lived in the five miles beyond.
sentences.zh: 另外五十人住在外围五英里的范围内。

sentences.en: Police began looking into each individual, but one by one, they were all ruled out.
sentences.zh: 警方开始调查每一个人，但一个接一个，他们的嫌疑都被排除了。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Keith Pepini agreed to participate in a polygraph teSt.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，基思·佩皮尼同意参加测谎测试。

sentences.en: It concluded he was telling the truth when he said he wasn't involved in his wife's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 结论是，他说自己没有参与妻子的失踪时说的是实话。

sentences.en: This, along with Keith's confirmed alibi and the lack of physical evidence linking him to the crime scene, gave police the confidence to conclusively rule him out as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 这一点，加上基思得到证实的有不在场证明以及缺乏将他与犯罪现场联系起来的物证，让警方有信心最终排除了他作为嫌疑人的可能。

sentences.en: Being publicly cleared provided Keith with little relief.
sentences.zh: 公开洗清嫌疑并没有给基思带来多少宽慰。

sentences.en: He told People magazine,
sentences.zh: 他告诉《人物》杂志，

sentences.en: That is not where my head has been this whole time.
sentences.zh: 我这段时间的心思根本不在那上面。

sentences.en: My head has been trying to find my wife.
sentences.zh: 我的心思全在找我妻子上。

sentences.en: Police continued to explore all avenues, including the possibility that Sherry might have voluntarily run away.
sentences.zh: 警方继续探索所有途径，包括雪莉可能是自愿离家出走的可能性。

sentences.en: But as the days passed with no breakthroughs, local residents became consumed by fear.
sentences.zh: 但随着日复一日没有取得突破，当地居民陷入了恐惧之中。

sentences.en: They rallied behind the Pepini family, setting up a GoFundMe account to help with expenses.
sentences.zh: 他们声援佩皮尼一家，设立了一个GoFundMe账户来帮助筹集费用。

sentences.en: Missing person posters were plastered around town, urging people to be on the lookout for the 34-year-old.
sentences.zh: 寻人启事海报贴满了全城，敦促人们留意这位34岁的女子。

sentences.en: At a fence on the corner of Old Oregon Trail and Sunrise Drive, concerned citizens hung a bunch of helium balloons with the words,
sentences.zh: 在老俄勒冈小径和日出大道交汇处的栅栏上，关切的市民挂了一束氦气球，上面写着：

sentences.en: Bring Sherry Home, written on them.
sentences.zh: 带雪莉回家。

sentences.en: A $50,000 reward for information was announced.
sentences.zh: 悬赏5万美元征集线索的通告已经发布。

sentences.en: The Pepini family hired a private investigator, who began working on the possibility that Sherry had been abducted as part of a human trafficking ring.
sentences.zh: 佩皮尼一家雇了一名私家侦探，开始朝雪莉被当作贩卖人口集团目标而遭绑架的方向调查。

sentences.en: The Pepini's house was only a few miles from the Interstate 5 freeway, an area known to be used for criminal activity by Mexican cartels.
sentences.zh: 佩皮尼的家距离5号州际公路只有几英里，该地区以墨西哥贩毒集团进行犯罪活动而闻名。

sentences.en: A trailer near their house was also a known drug den.
sentences.zh: 他们家附近的一个拖车屋也是一个众所周知的毒窝。

sentences.en: Maybe someone frequenting the trailer had spotted Sherry and recognised her as an easy target.
sentences.zh: 也许经常出入这个拖车屋的人发现了雪莉，并认出她是一个容易下手的目标。

sentences.en: Police were quick to dispel this theory.
sentences.zh: 警方很快驳斥了这一理论。

sentences.en: Victims of sex trafficking are typically young and childless.
sentences.zh: 性贩运的受害者通常年轻且没有孩子。

sentences.en: But as others argued, Sherry looked notably young for her age.
sentences.zh: 但正如其他人所争辩的那样，雪莉看起来比实际年龄年轻得多。

sentences.en: At 5 foot 3 inches tall, with a petite 105 pound frame and long blonde hair, some believed Sherry could pass for 18.
sentences.zh: 她身高5英尺3英寸，拥有105磅的娇小身材和长金发，一些人认为雪莉看起来就像18岁。

sentences.en: Had she been targeted at random, it was possible the perpetrator had mistaken her for a much younger woman.
sentences.zh: 如果她是随机成为目标的，凶手很有可能把她误认为是一个年轻得多的女性。

sentences.en: By November 17,
sentences.zh: 到了11月17日，

sentences.en: Sherry Pepini had been missing for 15 days.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·佩皮尼已经失踪了15天。

sentences.en: The FBI became involved as the local rumour mill swung into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 随着当地谣言四起，联邦调查局介入了调查。

sentences.en: Some theorised that Sherry could have been taken by a stalker.
sentences.zh: 有人推测雪莉可能是被跟踪狂抓走的。

sentences.en: What if someone had been watching her movements closely and knew exactly when she'd be alone on the remote running trail?
sentences.zh: 如果有人一直在密切关注她的行踪，并且确切知道她什么时候会在偏僻的跑步小径上独自一人呢？

sentences.en: There was also talk of a possible affair.
sentences.zh: 当时也有人猜测这是一起婚外情。

sentences.en: Some speculated that Sherry could have been involved with a married man whose scorned lover had abducted her as part of a revenge plot.
sentences.zh: 有人推测，雪莉可能和一个已婚男子有染，而那名心生怨恨的情敌为了报复，将她绑架了。

sentences.en: Despite Keith Pepini being publicly cleared, many members of the public continued to cast suspicion on him.
sentences.zh: 尽管基思·佩皮尼在公开场合洗脱了嫌疑，但许多公众仍然对他抱有怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Keith Pepini did his best to hold it together for the sake of his young children.
sentences.zh: 为了年幼的孩子，基思·佩皮尼咬紧牙关，强打精神。

sentences.en: He held on to hopes that Sherry was still alive and being held somewhere.
sentences.zh: 他依然抱着希望，相信雪莉还活着，被关押在某个地方。

sentences.en: Making a teary appeal to his wife on television,
sentences.zh: 他在电视上含泪向妻子喊话，

sentences.en: Keith said,
sentences.zh: 基思说道：

sentences.en: If Sherry is listening, I want to say that we are trying.
sentences.zh: “如果雪莉能听到，我想说我们一直在努力。”

sentences.en: We're trying the best we can and I'm so sorry that I'm not there.
sentences.zh: “我们尽了最大努力，很抱歉我没能陪在你身边。”

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: “我爱你。”

sentences.en: Addressing the perpetrator directly,
sentences.zh: 基思直接向绑架者喊话，

sentences.en: Keith told People magazine,
sentences.zh: 他在接受《人物》杂志采访时表示：

sentences.en: I just want her back and I want her back safe.
sentences.zh: “我只想要她回来，平平安安地回来。”

sentences.en: Just bring her home.
sentences.zh: “把她带回家就行。”

sentences.en: Please bring her back.
sentences.zh: “请把她送回来。”

sentences.en: The sooner the better.
sentences.zh: “越快越好。”

sentences.en: A wealthy businessman was passing through Redding when he learned of Sherry's disappearance and heard Keith's heartfelt pleas for her safe return.
sentences.zh: 一名富商路过雷丁时，得知了雪莉失踪的消息，并听到了基思恳求她平安归来的肺腑之言。

sentences.en: Something about the case struck a chord with the man.
sentences.zh: 这个案子的某些地方触动了这名男子心底的弦。

sentences.en: Even though he didn't know Sherry or the Pepini family, the pain they were experiencing seemed unimaginable.
sentences.zh: 尽管他不认识雪莉，也不认识佩皮尼一家，但他们所承受的痛苦似乎难以想象。

sentences.en: He began thinking about ways that he could help out.
sentences.zh: 他开始琢磨自己能帮上什么忙。

sentences.en: That's when the idea struck him.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，他灵光一闪。

sentences.en: What about a reverse ransom?
sentences.zh: 为什么不来个反向悬赏呢？

sentences.en: After reaching out to Keith Pepini and getting the go-ahead, the businessman, who chose to remain anonymous, created a website titled SherryPepini.com.
sentences.zh: 在联系了基思·佩皮尼并获得首肯后，这名选择保持匿名的商人创建了一个名为 SherryPepini.com 的网站。

sentences.en: He made a bizarre offer to whoever had abducted Sherry.
sentences.zh: 他向绑架雪莉的人提出了一项离奇的交易。

sentences.en: Return her safely and receive an undisclosed six-figure reward with no questions asked.
sentences.zh: 只要安全送回她，就能获得一笔未公开的六位数报酬，而且不问任何原因。

sentences.en: The donor wrote,
sentences.zh: 这位捐赠者写道：

sentences.en: I am willing to pay you in whatever way you can creatively think about where you feel safe and where nothing can be tracked to you.
sentences.zh: “我愿意按照你认为有创意的方式向你支付报酬，只要你觉得安全，且没有任何追踪痕迹。”

sentences.en: I will not communicate with the police and sheriff's department regarding any details about this offer.
sentences.zh: “关于这笔悬赏的任何细节，我都不会与警方和治安官部门沟通。”

sentences.en: Law enforcement were firmly against this tactic for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 执法部门坚决反对这种做法，原因有几个。

sentences.en: For one, there still wasn't enough evidence to unequivocally confirm that Sherry Pepini had been abducted.
sentences.zh: 首先，当时仍然没有足够的证据来明确证实雪莉·佩皮尼遭到了绑架。

sentences.en: If she had, her kidnapper had made no attempt to demand any kind of ransom.
sentences.zh: 即使她真的被绑架了，绑匪也从未试图提出任何形式的赎金要求。

sentences.en: Two, releasing an offer like this left the Pepini family vulnerable to scam artists.
sentences.zh: 其次，发布这样的悬赏会让佩皮尼一家容易成为骗子下手的目标。

sentences.en: And thirdly, financially rewarding someone for their criminal activity only served to encourage future copycats.
sentences.zh: 第三，用金钱奖励犯罪行为只会助长未来模仿犯罪的气焰。

sentences.en: The anonymous donor was undeterred.
sentences.zh: 这位匿名捐赠者并没有被吓退。

sentences.en: He hired an independent hostage negotiator named Cameron Gamble to act as his spokesman and gave a deadline of 100 hours, writing on his website,
sentences.zh: 他雇佣了一位名叫卡梅伦·甘布尔的独立人质谈判专家作为他的代言人，并设定了100小时的最后期限，他在网站上写道：

sentences.en: Once I leave town, this offer is off the table.
sentences.zh: “一旦我离开小镇，这个悬赏就此作废。”

sentences.en: Public reaction to the offer was mixed.
sentences.zh: 公众对这项悬赏的反应褒贬不一。

sentences.en: Some viewed it as a novel way to help solve missing person cases.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为这是协助解决失踪人口案件的一种新颖方法。

sentences.en: Skeptics believed it was nothing more than a publicity stunt for Cameron Gamble to promote his hostage negotiation business.
sentences.zh: 怀疑论者则认为这不过是卡梅伦·甘布尔为宣传其人质谈判业务而搞的噱头。

sentences.en: Either way, the 100-hour deadline came and went without anyone coming forward.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，100小时的最后期限转瞬即逝，却没有一个人露面。

sentences.en: The donor withdrew the controversial reverse ransom offer, but said the unclaimed money would be added towards the existing $50,000 reward offered by law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 捐赠者撤回了这项备受争议的反向悬赏，但表示这笔无人认领的资金将追加到执法部门现有的5万美元悬赏金中。

sentences.en: By November 23, Sherry Pepini had been missing for three weeks.
sentences.zh: 截至11月23日，雪莉·佩皮尼已经失踪了三个星期。

sentences.en: Investigators had chased over 400 leads and executed 20 search warrants to obtain data relating to cell phone records, social media accounts, banking information, and emails.
sentences.zh: 调查人员已经追查了400多条线索，并执行了20份搜查令，以获取有关手机通话记录、社交媒体账号、银行信息和电子邮件的数据。

sentences.en: A check of Sherry Pepini's cell phone revealed she had recently deleted a text message exchange with a female contact.
sentences.zh: 对雪莉·佩皮尼手机的检查显示，她最近删除了一段与一个女性联系人的短信交流。

sentences.en: But when police looked into this contact, they realised it wasn't a woman at all.
sentences.zh: 但当警方调查这个联系人时，他们发现对方根本不是女性。

sentences.en: Sherry had been conversing with a man from Michigan named Donovan.
sentences.zh: 雪莉一直在和一个名叫多诺万的密歇根男子聊天。

sentences.en: But had hidden his number under a woman's name.
sentences.zh: 但她把他的电话号码伪装成一个女人的名字存了起来。

sentences.en: The two had been texting between October 29 and November 1, the day before Sherry went missing.
sentences.zh: 两人在10.29至11.1期间互发了短信，也就是雪莉失踪的前一天。

sentences.en: Donovan had been in San Francisco for a work conference and the two discussed the possibility of meeting up in Reading.
sentences.zh: 多诺万当时在旧金山参加一个工作会议，两人讨论了在雷丁见面的可能性。

sentences.en: However, it was a five-hour drive between the two cities, which Donovan deemed too far.
sentences.zh: 然而，两座城市之间开车需要五个小时，多诺万觉得太远了。

sentences.en: Their rendezvous didn't eventuate, but for investigators, this was a solid lead.
sentences.zh: 他们的幽会最终没有成行，但对调查人员来说，这是一条坚实的线索。

sentences.en: What if Donovan had decided to swing by Reading after all?
sentences.zh: 万一多诺万最终还是决定顺路去趟雷丁呢？

sentences.en: They obtained Donovan's travel records and confirmed that he had returned to Michigan on November 2, the day of Sherry's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 他们获取了多诺万的出行记录，并证实他在11月2日（即雪莉失踪当天）已经回到了密歇根。

sentences.en: Investigators flew to Michigan to visit Donovan's apartment while he was at work.
sentences.zh: 调查人员飞往密歇根，趁多诺万上班时搜查了他的公寓。

sentences.en: They searched the premises, but found no sign of Sherry Pepini or anything else incriminating.
sentences.zh: 他们搜查了住所，但没有发现任何雪莉·佩皮尼的踪迹，也没有找到其他任何 incriminating（指 incriminating 对应下文，此处译为：能定罪的）证据。

sentences.en: When police arrived at Donovan's work for an interview, he seemed shocked.
sentences.zh: 当警方来到多诺万的工作单位对其实施面谈时，他显得十分震惊。

sentences.en: According to Donovan, he had met Sherry Pepini in 2011 when she was in Michigan for a work trip.
sentences.zh: 据多诺万说，他和雪莉·佩皮尼于2011年相识，当时雪莉去密歇根出差。

sentences.en: He later told the Sacramento Bee that he found her to be, quote, drop-dead gorgeous.
sentences.zh: 他后来告诉《萨克拉门托蜂报》，他发现她“美得惊艳（原文用 quote）”。

sentences.en: Donovan said there was something pretty magical about her.
sentences.zh: 多诺万说她身上有一种相当神奇的特质。

sentences.en: Sherry made no mention of the fact that she was married and the two had spent the weekend together.
sentences.zh: 雪莉绝口不提自己已婚的事实，两人一起度过了整个周末。

sentences.en: Over the years, they continued to send the occasional flirty message, but it never went beyond that.
sentences.zh: 多年来，他们偶尔还会互发带有调情意味的信息，但从未超越这个界限。

sentences.en: Donovan assumed the recent contact from Sherry was due to her seeing his social media post about being in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 多诺万猜测，雪莉最近联系他是因为看到了他在社交媒体上发布自己身处旧金山的动态。

sentences.en: Donovan denied being anywhere near Redding on the day Sherry went missing.
sentences.zh: 多诺万否认自己在雪莉失踪当天去过雷丁附近任何地方。

sentences.en: He had data on his cell phone to prove he was in San Francisco at the time and others were able to confirm his alibi.
sentences.zh: 他手机里的数据证明他当时在旧金山，其他人也能够证实他的不在场证明。

sentences.en: For investigators, this was a major blow.
sentences.zh: 这对调查人员来说是一个沉重的打击。

sentences.en: It was back to the drawing board.
sentences.zh: 一切只能从头开始了。

sentences.en: Thursday, November 24, was Thanksgiving Day.
sentences.zh: 11月24日，星期四，是感恩节。

sentences.en: What was typically a day of celebration for the Pepini family was now a stark reminder that 22 days had passed with no sign of Sherry.
sentences.zh: 对佩皮尼一家来说，这本该是个庆祝的日子，如今却成了一个残酷的提醒：22天过去了，雪莉依然杳无音讯。

sentences.en: Before her disappearance, she'd been enthusiastically making plans with her in-laws about the day.
sentences.zh: 在她失踪之前，她还曾满腔热情地和公公婆婆计划着这一天。

sentences.en: She'd intended on making sweet potatoes, her children's favourite.
sentences.zh: 她原本打算做孩子们最喜欢的红薯。

sentences.en: Instead, members of the Redding community planned to gather later in the afternoon to show support for Sherry's loved ones.
sentences.zh: 然而，雷丁社区的成员们计划在下午晚些时候聚集在一起，向雪莉的亲人们表达支持。

sentences.en: Keith Pepini got up before dawn to begin his day.
sentences.zh: 基思·佩皮尼黎明前就起床开始了一天的工作。

sentences.en: He was in the bathroom shaving when his phone rang.
sentences.zh: 他正在浴室刮胡子时，电话响了。

sentences.en: On the other line was one of the detectives working on his wife's case.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是负责他妻子案件的一名侦探。

sentences.en: They finally had news.
sentences.zh: 他们终于有消息了。

sentences.en: Sherry Pepini had been found.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·佩皮尼找到了。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《罪案档案》继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: By 4.30am on Thanksgiving morning, traffic was already busy on the Interstate 5 highway in Yolo County, a rural area
sentences.zh: 感恩节早晨4点30分，优洛县农村地区的5号州际公路上，车流已经非常繁忙，

sentences.en: 140 miles south of Redding.
sentences.zh: 这里位于雷丁以南140英里处。

sentences.en: As motorists made their way to celebrate the holiday with friends and family, several passers-by noticed something strange on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 正当驾车者们赶着与亲朋好友共度节日时，几位路人注意到路边有些奇怪的景象。

sentences.en: Through the darkness, a panicked-looking woman was frantically waving a piece of fabric in the air, as though trying to attract attention.
sentences.zh: 在黑暗中，一个神色惊恐的女人正疯狂地在空中挥舞着一块织物，似乎在试图引起注意。

sentences.en: Unsure what to make of it, many continued onwards.
sentences.zh: 许多人拿不准是怎么回事，便继续往前开去。

sentences.en: One woman pulled over a little further down the highway to call 911 while a truck driver pulled over and addressed the woman directly.
sentences.zh: 一名女子将车停在稍远一点的高速公路旁拨打911，而一名卡车司机则将车停下，直接跟那名女子搭话。

sentences.en: In a state of distress, she told him her name was Sherry Pepini and that she needed an ambulance.
sentences.zh: 她情绪崩溃，告诉对方自己叫雪莉·佩皮尼，需要一辆救护车。

sentences.en: She was covered in bruises and said that her vision was blurry.
sentences.zh: 她浑身是伤，并说自己的视线有些模糊。

sentences.en: Around her waist was a metal chain.
sentences.zh: 她的腰间缠着一条金属链条。

sentences.en: First responders arrived promptly and were shocked by what they saw.
sentences.zh: 急救人员迅速赶到现场，被眼前的景象惊呆了。

sentences.en: The woman who stood before them was a severe contrast to the vibrant, smiling face that had been plastered on posters and news bulletins.
sentences.zh: 站在他们面前的这个女人，与海报和新闻简报上那个充满活力、笑容满面的面孔形成了强烈对比。

sentences.en: Sherry Pepini was dressed in dirty grey sweatpants, a sweatshirt, and socks.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·佩皮尼穿着一条脏兮兮的灰色运动裤、一件运动衫和袜子。

sentences.en: Her waist-length blonde hair had been crudely hacked to her shoulders and she looked emaciated.
sentences.zh: 她及腰的金发被粗暴地剪到了肩膀处，整个人看起来骨瘦如柴。

sentences.en: She was disoriented, having no idea where she was or what day it was.
sentences.zh: 她神情恍惚，完全不知道自己身在何处，也不知道今天是星期几。

sentences.en: There were restraints around her ankles and zip-ties around her wrists, one of which was tethered to the chain around her waiSt.
sentences.zh: 她的脚踝上缠着束缚带，手腕上戴着扎带，其中一根扎带系在她腰间的链条上。

sentences.en: It was only upon being transferred to a nearby hospital that the full extent of Sherry's injuries became clear.
sentences.zh: 直到被转运到附近的医院，雪莉伤势的严重程度才完全显现出来。

sentences.en: Her body was covered in bruises in various states of healing, some yellow and others black and blue.
sentences.zh: 她的身体布满了处于不同恢复阶段的淤伤，有些呈黄色，有些则是青黑色。

sentences.en: The bridge of her nose was broken and there were rashes and burns all over her arms and legs.
sentences.zh: 她的鼻梁骨折了，四肢到处都是皮疹和烫伤。

sentences.en: Ligature marks were visible on her wrists and ankles.
sentences.zh: 她的手腕和脚踝上有明显的捆绑痕迹。

sentences.en: She had lost a little over 10 pounds, a significant amount given she only weighed
sentences.zh: 她瘦了十多磅，考虑到她失踪时体重只有

sentences.en: 105 pounds when she went missing.
sentences.zh: 105磅，这已经是个相当可观的数字了。

sentences.en: But the most horrific injury was on her right shoulder.
sentences.zh: 但最恐怖的伤口在她的右肩上。

sentences.en: Burned into her flesh were a series of undistinguishable letters, some scabbed and others already scarred.
sentences.zh: 她的皮肤上被烙上了一系列无法辨认的字母，有些已经结痂，有些则已留下了疤痕。

sentences.en: Sherry had been branded.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被烙上了印记。

sentences.en: When Keith Pepini arrived at the hospital, it was a teary reunion for the couple.
sentences.zh: 当基思·佩皮尼赶到医院时，这对夫妇迎来了泪水交织的重逢。

sentences.en: They hugged each other tightly for 20 minutes as Keith was overcome with conflicting emotions.
sentences.zh: 两人紧紧拥抱了20分钟，基思内心百感交集。

sentences.en: Relief that Sherry had been found alive and revulsion that someone could do something so horrible.
sentences.zh: 既有雪莉活着被找到的如释重负，也有对某人能做出如此残忍行径的极度厌恶。

sentences.en: Sherry was clearly traumatised and refused to speak to the police.
sentences.zh: 雪莉显然受到了极大的创伤，拒绝与警方对话。

sentences.en: She told Keith that law enforcement had been involved in her abduction and she therefore didn't trust anyone.
sentences.zh: 她告诉基思，执法部门也参与了她的绑架，因此她不信任任何人。

sentences.en: Instead, investigators gave Keith an audio recorder so that he could ask her questions himself.
sentences.zh: 无奈之下，调查人员给了基思一个录音笔，以便他自己向她提问。

sentences.en: According to Sherry, she'd been jogging the old Oregon Trail when a dark coloured SUV drove by and then backed up again.
sentences.zh: 据雪莉回忆，她当时正在老俄勒冈小道上慢跑，一辆深色SUV从旁驶过，随后又倒了回来。

sentences.en: Two Hispanic women were inside.
sentences.zh: 车里坐着两个拉美裔女人。

sentences.en: One of them beckoned her over saying they needed help with something.
sentences.zh: 其中一人冲她招手，说她们有什么事需要帮忙。

sentences.en: Sherry approached the vehicle but as she got closer, one of the women held up a small gun.
sentences.zh: 雪莉走近车子，但当她靠近时，其中一个女人举起了一把小枪。

sentences.en: She demanded that Sherry drop her phone and get into the car, reassuring her, we don't want to kill you.
sentences.zh: 她命令雪莉扔掉手机上车，并安抚她说：“我们不想杀你。”

sentences.en: Thinking quickly as she removed her headphones,
sentences.zh: 雪莉一边摘下耳机一边急中生智，

sentences.en: Sherry purposely pulled out several strands of her hair to leave behind as a clue.
sentences.zh: 故意拔下了好几缕头发留作线索。

sentences.en: Sherry got into the vehicle and the women put something over her head.
sentences.zh: 雪莉上了车，两个女人把某种东西套在她头上。

sentences.en: One of them struck her with something.
sentences.zh: 其中一人用什么东西击打她。

sentences.en: Sherry thought it might have been a taser.
sentences.zh: 雪莉觉得那可能是一把电击枪。

sentences.en: From there, everything went hazy.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，一切都变得模糊不清。

sentences.en: She tried to stay awake but kept losing consciousness.
sentences.zh: 她努力保持清醒，却不断失去意识。

sentences.en: The next thing she knew, she woke up in a strange room that had its windows boarded up from the inside.
sentences.zh: 等她再次恢复知觉时，她醒在一个陌生的房间里，窗户从里面被木板封死了。

sentences.en: There was nothing in the room except for a bed, a dresser and a closet.
sentences.zh: 房间里除了张床、一个五斗柜和一个衣柜外，空无一物。

sentences.en: All of her clothes were gone and she'd been redressed in a plain t-shirt.
sentences.zh: 她所有的衣服都不见了，身上换成了一件素色T恤。

sentences.en: Sherry stood on the bed and tried to look out the window only to discover it had also been boarded up from the outside.
sentences.zh: 雪莉站在床上试图向窗外张望，却发现窗户连外面也被钉上了木板。

sentences.en: She attempted to dislodge one of the boards but the two women came in and caught her in the act.
sentences.zh: 她试图撬下一块木板，结果两个女人进来当场抓获了她。

sentences.en: They yanked her down by her hair and hit her so hard that she saw stars.
sentences.zh: 她们拽着她的头发把她扯下来，狠狠地打了她一顿，打得她眼冒金星。

sentences.en: When Sherry came to, the dresser was gone and the bed was in its place.
sentences.zh: 当雪莉醒过来时，五斗柜不见了，取而代之的是那张床。

sentences.en: A chain had been tied around her waist which was bolted to the ceiling and hooked to a metal pole in the closet.
sentences.zh: 她的腰上拴着一条链子，链子一头固定在天花板上，另一头勾在衣柜里的金属杆上。

sentences.en: Over the coming days, the two women came and went from the room.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的日子里，这两个女人在这个房间里进进出出。

sentences.en: Sherry was mostly kept locked in the closet.
sentences.zh: 雪莉大部分时间都被反锁在衣柜里。

sentences.en: She was given a bucket full of kitty litter to use as a toilet and fed once daily with small portions of bread, gritty rice, porridge, and the occasional apple or fat off a piece
sentences.zh: 她被发配给一个装满猫砂的桶作为厕所，每天只喂食一次，食物包括一小份面包、粗糙的米饭、粥，偶尔还有一个苹果或是一块肥肉

sentences.en: of meat.
sentences.zh: 上的油。

sentences.en: Outside her door, a speaker blasted what Sherry described as, quote, that really annoying Mexican music a majority of the time.
sentences.zh: 在她的门外，一个扬声器循环播放着雪莉形容为“绝大多数时候都让人烦透了的墨西哥音乐”。

sentences.en: The two women yelled at her in Spanish which Sherry didn't understand and the older of the two occasionally beat her.
sentences.zh: 两个女人用雪莉听不懂的西班牙语冲她大喊大叫，年纪较大的那个偶尔还会殴打她。

sentences.en: Anytime Sherry made a sound, she was physically punished.
sentences.zh: 每当雪莉发出一点声音，她就会遭到肉体惩罚。

sentences.en: She was sometimes burnt with heated up kitchen utensils.
sentences.zh: 有时她们会用加热过的厨房用具烫伤她。

sentences.en: When she accidentally made a clanging noise with her chain, one of the women rushed in and cut off her ponytail, threatening,
sentences.zh: 当她不小心让链条发出铿锵的撞击声时，其中一个女人冲进来剪掉了她的马尾辫，并威胁道：

sentences.en: I'm going to send it to your mother.
sentences.zh: “我要把它寄给你妈。”

sentences.en: Sherry wasn't particularly close with her mother, so this comment led her to believe that her captors didn't know her and had taken her at random.
sentences.zh: 雪莉跟她母亲关系并不是特别亲密，所以这句话让她觉得绑架者并不认识她，而是随机绑走了她。

sentences.en: When Sherry questioned why they were doing this, one of them said, we sell you.
sentences.zh: 当雪莉质问她们为什么要这么做时，其中一人说：“我们要把你卖掉。”

sentences.en: The other added, your buyer is a cop.
sentences.zh: 另一个人补充道：“买你的人是个警察。”

sentences.en: The women read
sentences.zh: 这两个女人还念了

sentences.en: Sherry news articles about her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 关于雪莉失踪的新闻报道给她听。

sentences.en: One of them laughed as she said, no one believes you, everyone thinks you ran away.
sentences.zh: 其中一人笑着说：“没人相信你，大家都以为你是自己跑了。”

sentences.en: Guess what, the buyer's a cop, they're never going to find you.
sentences.zh: “你猜怎么着，买主是个警察，他们永远也找不到你。”

sentences.en: Sherry had no idea what to do.
sentences.zh: 雪莉完全不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: She tried to engage with her captors by offering to cook or clean for them in the hopes they would give her more information, but the women remained tight lipped.
sentences.zh: 她试图通过主动提出为她们做饭或打扫卫生来与绑匪套近乎，希望能从她们那里套出更多信息，但这两人始终守口如瓶。

sentences.en: With Sherry's limited knowledge of Spanish words, she thought she heard mention of traffic, cameras, medicine, and a delivery date.
sentences.zh: 凭借着对有限西班牙语单词的了解，雪莉觉得自己隐约听到了交通、摄像头、药物和一个交货日期的词眼。

sentences.en: Fearful of what that signified, she began making plans to escape.
sentences.zh: 由于害怕这意味着什么，她开始计划逃跑。

sentences.en: At one point, Sherry's captors forced her into the shower at gunpoint and told her to wash herself.
sentences.zh: 有一次，雪莉的绑架者用枪逼着她走进淋浴间，命令她洗澡。

sentences.en: As Sherry lathered herself with coconut scented body wash, the women became engaged in a conversation and lowered their guns.
sentences.zh: 当雪莉用散发着椰子香味的沐浴露擦洗身体时，两个女人开始交谈并放下了枪。

sentences.en: Recognising this as an opportunity, Sherry jumped on the younger woman and smashed her head into the toilet.
sentences.zh: 雪莉意识到这是一个机会，便扑向较年轻的那个女人，把她的头猛撞在马桶上。

sentences.en: She slipped and cut her foot in the process.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中她滑倒了，脚也受了伤。

sentences.en: The older woman dragged Sherry back to her room by her hair, forcing an unknown substance down her throat.
sentences.zh: 年长的女人抓住雪莉的头发把她拖回房间，并强行将某种不明物质灌进她喉咙里。

sentences.en: When Sherry made another attempt to escape, the women tied her to a table and slashed her t-shirt off from behind.
sentences.zh: 当雪莉再次试图逃跑时，两个女人把她绑在桌子上，从后面割破了她的 T 恤。

sentences.en: Already in agony from her healing breast implants, that's when the women branded her.
sentences.zh: 由于她正在愈合的隆胸手术本就疼痛难忍，就在这时，两个女人在她身上烙下了印记。

sentences.en: Sherry's captors told her this is what her buyer wanted.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的绑架者告诉她，这是买主要求的。

sentences.en: Along with the immense pain,
sentences.zh: 除了巨大的痛苦，

sentences.en: Sherry heard her skin make a sizzling, popping sound.
sentences.zh: 雪莉听到她的皮肤发出滋滋的爆裂声。

sentences.en: Too scared to make a noise, she kept her eyes clenched shut until it was over.
sentences.zh: 她吓得不敢作声，紧闭着双眼直到这一切结束。

sentences.en: While it was unclear what the words said, Sherry believed it said exodus, which she described as a really confusing
sentences.zh: 虽然不清楚上面写的是什么字，但雪莉认为上面写的是“出埃及记”，她形容这是一段

sentences.en: Bible passage.
sentences.zh: 非常令人费解的圣经选段。

sentences.en: To maintain her strength and sanity, Sherry spent some of her spare time doing yoga.
sentences.zh: 为了保持精力和理智，雪莉利用一些空闲时间练瑜伽。

sentences.en: She scratched away at the drywall inside the closet in the hopes she might chip a big enough hole to escape.
sentences.zh: 她抓挠着壁橱里的干墙，希望能凿出一个足够大的洞逃跑。

sentences.en: She thought about her children constantly.
sentences.zh: 她无时无刻不在想着自己的孩子。

sentences.en: Over time,
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，

sentences.en: Sherry sensed that the younger of her captors was starting to soften.
sentences.zh: 雪莉感觉到两个绑架者中较年轻的那位态度开始软化。

sentences.en: Sometimes when the older woman beat Sherry, the younger one would drag her off.
sentences.zh: 有时年长的女人殴打雪莉时，年轻的会把她拉开。

sentences.en: Then one day,
sentences.zh: 直到有一天，

sentences.en: Sherry was sitting on the bed when she heard a gunshot.
sentences.zh: 雪莉正坐在床上，突然听到了一声枪响。

sentences.en: Terrified, she hid in the closet.
sentences.zh: 她吓得躲进了壁橱。

sentences.en: It sounded like someone was gathering up keys to leave the house.
sentences.zh: 听起来好像有人在收集钥匙准备离开房子。

sentences.en: Then came the blasting mariachi music.
sentences.zh: 接着传来了震耳欲聋的墨西哥玛利亚奇音乐。

sentences.en: Sherry started screaming and yanking on her chains until she eventually fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 雪莉开始尖叫并猛拉身上的链子，直到最终精疲力竭睡着了。

sentences.en: When she woke up, the younger of her captors came in and gave her a plate of food.
sentences.zh: 当她醒来时，较年轻的绑架者走了进来，给了她一盘食物。

sentences.en: Sherry ate it, but soon started to feel nauseous and dizzy.
sentences.zh: 雪莉吃下去了，但不久便开始感到恶心和头晕。

sentences.en: She could barely stand.
sentences.zh: 她几乎站不稳了。

sentences.en: The younger captor came back in and hit Sherry in the face.
sentences.zh: 年轻的绑架者再次走了进来，打了雪莉的脸。

sentences.en: She had laid a fresh sweatsuit out on the bed and insinuated that
sentences.zh: 她在床铺上摆好了一套崭新的运动服，暗示

sentences.en: Sherry get dressed into it.
sentences.zh: 雪莉换上它。

sentences.en: Sherry did so, after which the woman hit her again and placed something over her head so that she couldn't see.
sentences.zh: 雪莉照做了，随后那女人又打了她，并给她的头上套了个东西让她什么也看不见。

sentences.en: Sherry was then led outside and into a vehicle.
sentences.zh: 接着雪莉被带到屋外并塞进了一辆车里。

sentences.en: Sharp restraints were secured around her ankles and wrists, one of which was secured to the vehicle.
sentences.zh: 她的脚踝和手腕上被绑上了紧绷的束缚物，其中一个还被固定在车上。

sentences.en: Sherry didn't know who else was in the car.
sentences.zh: 雪莉不知道车里还有谁。

sentences.en: There were no voices, only the sound of the radio.
sentences.zh: 车里没有任何说话声，只有收音机的声音。

sentences.en: Sherry tried to keep track of how far they drove by counting the number of songs, but she kept falling asleep.
sentences.zh: 雪莉试图通过数歌曲的数量来记录他们开了多远，但她一直在打瞌睡。

sentences.en: Eventually, the car stopped.
sentences.zh: 最终，车停了下来。

sentences.en: The younger captor ordered
sentences.zh: 年轻的绑架者命令

sentences.en: Sherry to get out.
sentences.zh: 雪莉下车。

sentences.en: Sherry was terrified.
sentences.zh: 雪莉吓坏了。

sentences.en: She started crying.
sentences.zh: 她哭了起来。

sentences.en: The woman cut her restraints, pushed her out the door, and drove off.
sentences.zh: 那女人割断了她的束缚，把她推出车门，然后开车走了。

sentences.en: Sherry removed her head covering, realising it was a pillowcase.
sentences.zh: 雪莉摘下头上的罩子，发现那是一个枕套。

sentences.en: She looked around at her rural surroundings and had no idea where she was.
sentences.zh: 她环顾四周荒凉的环境，完全不知道自己身在何处。

sentences.en: She began to run.
sentences.zh: 她开始奔跑。

sentences.en: Eventually, she came to a building, but it was locked, so she started running down the dark highway, waving the pillowcase and screaming at the top of her lungs.
sentences.zh: 最终，她来到了一栋建筑前，但门锁着，于是她开始沿着黑暗的高速公路奔跑，挥舞着枕套，歇斯底里地尖叫着。

sentences.en: She screamed so hard that she could taste blood in the back of her throat.
sentences.zh: 她嗓子都快喊破了，甚至能尝到喉咙深处的血腥味。

sentences.en: Car after car sped past without stopping.
sentences.zh: 一辆又一辆的车呼啸而过，没有一辆停下来。

sentences.en: Sherry wondered if they could see her restraints and were deterred from stopping because they thought she was an escaped prisoner.
sentences.zh: 雪莉纳闷他们是不是看到了她身上的束缚物，以为她是逃犯而不敢停车。

sentences.en: She tried to hide them under her clothes until a trucker eventually stopped.
sentences.zh: 她试图把束缚物藏在衣服下面，直到最后有一辆卡车司机停了下来。

sentences.en: Safe in hospital with her husband,
sentences.zh: 在医院里与丈夫团聚并安顿下来后，

sentences.en: Sherry was thoroughly examined.
sentences.zh: 雪莉接受了全面的检查。

sentences.en: She was adamant that she hadn't endured any form of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 她坚决否认自己经受过任何形式的性侵犯。

sentences.en: This was supported by medical exaMs.
sentences.zh: 体检结果证实了这一点。

sentences.en: Toxicology tests came up clean for narcotics, ruling out the possibility that
sentences.zh: 毒理学测试显示没有麻醉品成分，排除了

sentences.en: Sherry had been drugged.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被下药的可能性。

sentences.en: Her clothing was sent off for DNA testing.
sentences.zh: 她的衣服被送去进行 DNA 检测。

sentences.en: On Thanksgiving afternoon, members of the Reading community gathered in
sentences.zh: 感恩节下午，雷丁社区的成员们聚集在一起

sentences.en: Sherry's honour as plant, unaware that she'd been found alive.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念雪莉，当时他们并不知道她已经被找到且安然无恙。

sentences.en: When the good news was revealed a few hours later, Sherry's sister Sheila thanked their supporters, saying,
sentences.zh: 几个小时后好消息公布，雪莉的姐姐希拉向支持者们表示感谢，她说：

sentences.en: Everyone's tireless efforts have made our family whole again this
sentences.zh: 多亏了大家坚持不懈的努力，才让我们这个家庭在这个感恩节

sentences.en: Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 重新团聚。

sentences.en: news of Sherry's escape gripped the nation.
sentences.zh: 雪莉逃生的消息轰动了全国。

sentences.en: The public were hungry for details, but the
sentences.zh: 公众渴望了解细节，但

sentences.en: Papini family requested privacy during this time of healing.
sentences.zh: 帕皮尼一家在这个疗伤的时期请求保持隐私。

sentences.en: Over the coming days, investigators gently probed Sherry for any more details she could remember that might help them catch her abductors.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的日子里，调查人员温和地盘问雪莉，看她是否能想起更多有助于抓住绑架者的细节。

sentences.en: While Sherry tried to keep things light-hearted, her trauma was obvious.
sentences.zh: 尽管雪莉试图让气氛轻松一些，但她的创伤显而易见。

sentences.en: She hugged her knees to her chest, her eyes mostly cast downward, as she did her best to provide every possible piece of information.
sentences.zh: 她双膝抱胸，目光大多朝下，竭尽全力提供所有可能的信息。

sentences.en: The two women had worn masks over the bottom halves of their faces, so
sentences.zh: 这两个女人下半边脸都戴着面具，所以

sentences.en: Sherry never got a complete look at them, but she remembered other details.
sentences.zh: 雪莉从未看清她们的全貌，但她记住了其他细节。

sentences.en: The older of the pair had long, straight, dark hair that was showing signs of graying.
sentences.zh: 年长的那个头发又长又直且黑，已经有变白的迹象。

sentences.en: She had dark eyes and thick, bushy eyebrows.
sentences.zh: 她有一双黑眼睛和浓密粗重的眉毛。

sentences.en: She was roughly three inches taller than Sherry, heavy-set, and spoke with a raspy voice.
sentences.zh: 她比雪莉高大约三英寸，体型偏胖，说话声音沙哑。

sentences.en: Her breath smelt like sweetened coffee.
sentences.zh: 她的口气闻起来像加糖的咖啡。

sentences.en: The younger woman had dark, curly hair that had been smoothed with product, thin, over-tweezed eyebrows, and wore large hoop earrings.
sentences.zh: 年轻的女人留着黑色的卷发，抹过美发产品，眉毛很细、修剪过度，戴着大号圆环耳环。

sentences.en: She was a bit shorter than
sentences.zh: 她比雪莉

sentences.en: Sherry, with a slightly muscular build and hairy arMs.
sentences.zh: 稍矮一些，身材微壮，手臂上有毛发。

sentences.en: Sherry struggled to recall details about the clothing either of the women had been wearing, other than the fact they always wore leather gloves.
sentences.zh: 雪莉很难回想起两人穿过的衣物细节，只记得她们总是戴着皮手套。

sentences.en: The pair fought often, and
sentences.zh: 两人经常吵架，

sentences.en: Sherry regularly overheard the older woman hit the younger one.
sentences.zh: 雪莉经常听到年长的女人殴打年轻的女人。

sentences.en: As for the location where she was held, Sherry had no idea.
sentences.zh: 至于她被囚禁的地方，雪莉一无所知。

sentences.en: She sometimes heard birds outside, but because of the speaker outside her door, she never heard anything else.
sentences.zh: 她有时能听到外面的鸟叫声，但由于门外有扬声器，她再也听不到其他声音了。

sentences.en: It was always cold, possibly raining every night, and she could smell a fireplace.
sentences.zh: 那里总是很冷，可能每天晚上都在下雨，她还能闻到壁炉的味道。

sentences.en: Anytime she made a noise, her captors came in and took her blankets away as punishment.
sentences.zh: 每当她发出声音，绑架者就会进来拿走她的毯子作为惩罚。

sentences.en: The bathroom had a unique layout which Sherry was able to describe in detail, right down to a crack in the shower tile.
sentences.zh: 浴室的布局很独特，雪莉能够详细描述，甚至能精确到淋浴瓷砖上的一道裂缝。

sentences.en: She never saw the outside of the building.
sentences.zh: 她从未见过这栋建筑的外观。

sentences.en: To maintain the integrity of the investigation, police made the strategic decision to withhold details about Sherry's time in captivity, including the branding.
sentences.zh: 为了维护调查的完整性，警方做出战略决定，隐去了雪莉被囚禁期间的细节，包括烙印。

sentences.en: But this silence led to speculation from cynics that the whole kidnapping had been a hoax.
sentences.zh: 但这种沉默引发了愤世嫉俗者的猜测，认为整起绑架案是一场骗局。

sentences.en: If the police were so vocal about seeking answers when Sherry went missing, why go quiet when she was returned safely?
sentences.zh: 如果警方在雪莉失踪时如此大声疾呼地寻求答案，为什么在她安全返回时却变得沉默了？

sentences.en: Was it possible the whole thing had been a publicity stunt by Cameron
sentences.zh: 难道这一切毕竟是人质谈判专家卡梅伦

sentences.en: Gamble, the hostage negotiator, after all?
sentences.zh: 甘布尔的一场炒作吗？

sentences.en: Or perhaps Keith and Sherry had crafted the elaborate plot for financial gain and fame?
sentences.zh: 或者也许基斯和雪莉为了谋取金钱和名利精心策划了这场阴谋？

sentences.en: Investigators had considered this possibility, but unless they had evidence to prove otherwise, they had no reason to treat the abduction as anything other than a legitimate crime.
sentences.zh: 调查人员曾考虑过这种可能性，但除非有相反的证据，否则他们没有理由将这起绑架案视为普通犯罪之外的事情。

sentences.en: It was a lesson learned the hard way by Vallejo police just 180 miles south of Reading.
sentences.zh: 瓦列霍警方在距离雷丁以南仅 180 英里处付出了沉重的教训。

sentences.en: The year before Sherry Pepini's abduction, a Vallejo man named Aaron
sentences.zh: 在雪莉·佩皮尼被绑架的前一年，瓦列霍一名叫

sentences.en: Quinn called police to report a home invasion.
sentences.zh: 亚伦·奎因的男子报警称发生了入室抢劫。

sentences.en: He claimed that a gunman had broken into his home and forced him and his girlfriend, Denise Huskins, to drink tea laced with sleeping pills.
sentences.zh: 他声称一名枪手闯入他的家中，强迫他和女友丹妮丝·胡斯金斯喝下了掺有安眠药的茶。

sentences.en: They were blindfolded and tied up in the closet, where the gunman played a pre-recorded message.
sentences.zh: 他们被蒙上双眼并绑在壁橱里，枪手在那里播放了一段录音。

sentences.en: It explained that the couple had been targeted by a criminal group who were going to hold Denise captive unless
sentences.zh: 录音解释说，这对夫妇被一个犯罪集团盯上了，如果

sentences.en: Aaron paid an $8,500 ransom within
sentences.zh: 亚伦不在

sentences.en: 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 48 小时内支付 8500 美元赎金，他们就会扣押丹妮丝。

sentences.en: When Aaron woke up hours later, Denise was gone.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后亚伦醒来时，丹妮丝已经不见了。

sentences.en: He reported the incident to police, but the story was so outlandish that they thought he was making it up.
sentences.zh: 他向警方报案，但这个故事太离奇了，以至于警方认为他是捏造的。

sentences.en: When Denise resurfaced two days later, claiming to have been held captive and raped, both law enforcement and the media palmed it off as a wild hoax.
sentences.zh: 两天后丹妮丝再次现身，声称自己被囚禁并遭到强奸，但执法部门和媒体都将其斥为一场荒诞的恶作剧。

sentences.en: Three months later, police were investigating an unrelated home invasion when they uncovered evidence linking the perpetrator to Denise
sentences.zh: 三个月后，警方在调查一起无关的入室抢劫案时，发现了将犯罪嫌疑人与丹妮丝

sentences.en: Huskins and Aaron Quinn.
sentences.zh: 胡斯金斯和亚伦·奎因联系起来的证据。

sentences.en: It turned out the couple had been telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 事实证明这对夫妇说的是实话。

sentences.en: The perpetrator, a disbarred attorney named Matthew Muller, was tried and sentenced to 31 years in prison.
sentences.zh: 罪魁祸首是一名被吊销执照的律师，名叫马修·穆勒，他经审判被判处 31 年监禁。

sentences.en: Vallejo police were forced to publicly apologise to Denise and Aaron, who were awarded a $2.5 million compensation payout.
sentences.zh: 瓦列霍警方被迫公开向丹妮丝和亚伦道歉，两人获得了 250 万美元的赔偿金。

sentences.en: Investigators in the Sherry Pepini case were determined not to make a similar mistake.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·佩皮尼案的调查人员决心不犯类似错误。

sentences.en: Keith Pepini released an exclusive statement to national news program
sentences.zh: 基斯·佩皮尼向全国新闻节目

sentences.en: Good Morning America to address the rumours surrounding his wife's case head-on.
sentences.zh: 《早安美国》发表独家声明，正面回应有关他妻子案件的谣言。

sentences.en: He acknowledged the, quote, double-edged sword that is social media.
sentences.zh: 他承认了用他的话说“一把双刃剑”的社交媒体。

sentences.en: While modern technology had allowed news of Sherry's disappearance to spread quickly, those same people who helped spread the word now expected answers
sentences.zh: 虽然现代技术让雪莉失踪的消息得以迅速传播，但那些曾经帮忙传播消息的人现在却期望

sentences.en: instantly and became angry when they didn't get the gory details.
sentences.zh: 立即得到答案，并在没有得到血腥细节时变得愤怒。

sentences.en: Keith said,
sentences.zh: 基斯说：

sentences.en: Those people should be ashamed of their malicious, subhuman behaviour.
sentences.zh: 这些人应该为他们恶毒、非人道的行为感到羞耻。

sentences.en: We are not going to allow those people to take away our spirit, love or rejoice in our girl found alive and home where she belongs.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不允许这些人带走我们的精神、爱，或是剥夺我们为找到女孩并让她回到她所属的家而欢庆的权力。

sentences.en: I do not see a purpose in addressing each preposterous lie.
sentences.zh: 我觉得没有必要去反驳每一个荒谬的谎言。

sentences.en: Instead, may I give you a glimpse of the mixture of horror and elation that was my experience of reuniting with the love of my life and mother of our children.
sentences.zh: 相反，请让我带你们一窥我与挚爱以及我们孩子的母亲重聚时，那种惊恐与狂喜交织的体验。

sentences.en: Keith went on to provide a harrowing account of Sherry's ordeal, complete with the details of her injuries, including the branding.
sentences.zh: 基斯接着讲述了雪莉遭受的痛苦经历，其中包含了她受伤的细节，包括烙印。

sentences.en: He remarked,
sentences.zh: 他评论道：

sentences.en: Nothing could have prepared me for what I was about to see upon my arrival at the hospital, nor the details of the true hell I was about to hear.
sentences.zh: 我到达医院时看到的景象，以及我即将听到的真正人间地狱的细节，没有什么能让我做好心理准备。

sentences.en: Acknowledging the tireless support of law enforcement and the public,
sentences.zh: 在感谢执法部门和公众的不懈支持时，

sentences.en: Keith said.
sentences.zh: 基斯说道。

sentences.en: Thank you to the many incredible humans that have never known Sherry that facilitated in sharing our heartbreak across the globe.
sentences.zh: 感谢许多从未见过雪莉、却在全世界分享我们心碎的不可思议的人们。

sentences.en: Sherry has always captured my heart and it is no surprise that she has captured hearts not only through the country, but throughout the world.
sentences.zh: 雪莉一直俘获着我的心，毫无疑问，她不仅俘获了全国人民的心，也俘获了全世界的心。

sentences.en: The following day, police held a press conference to acknowledge Sherry Papini's courage.
sentences.zh: 第二天，警方召开新闻发布会，赞扬了雪莉·帕皮尼的勇气。

sentences.en: They released brief details about her two captors and appealed for anyone with information to come forward.
sentences.zh: 他们公布了关于她两名绑架者的简短细节，并呼吁知情者挺身而出。

sentences.en: The fact that Sherry had overheard the perpetrators talking about a buyer and getting paid gave weight to the human trafficking theory.
sentences.zh: 雪莉无意中听到作案者谈论买家和拿钱，这使得人口贩卖的理论更有分量。

sentences.en: Maybe the women had kidnapped Sherry at random, thinking she was much younger.
sentences.zh: 也许这两个女人是随机绑架了雪莉，以为她年轻得多。

sentences.en: When they realised she was a 34-year-old mother, they didn't know how to proceed, hence why they held her captive for so long and were constantly bickering.
sentences.zh: 当她们发现她是一个 34 岁的母亲时，不知道该如何处理，这就是为什么她们把她囚禁了那么久并且经常争吵。

sentences.en: But if this was the case, it would be highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 但如果是这样的话，那就太不寻常了。

sentences.en: In the United States, white women are rarely abducted for sex trafficking.
sentences.zh: 在美国，白人女性极少因性贩卖而被绑架。

sentences.en: Victims usually know they're exploiters, who are often tricked into willingly going with them after being promised a better life.
sentences.zh: 受害者通常认识她们的剥削者，而这些剥削者往往是通过承诺更美好的生活来诱骗受害者自愿跟他们走的。

sentences.en: Perpetrators involved are typically professionals.
sentences.zh: 涉案的罪犯通常是专业人士。

sentences.en: It would be highly unusual for someone involved in trafficking to let a victim go, as it risked exposing the entire ring.
sentences.zh: 贩卖人口的相关人员释放受害者是极其罕见的，因为这有暴露整个犯罪团伙的风险。

sentences.en: The fact that Sherry was branded also raised questions.
sentences.zh: 雪莉被烙印的事实也引发了疑问。

sentences.en: Some believed this type of torture was typical for traffickers who wanted to maintain control over their victim, while others questioned why a sex trafficker would
sentences.zh: 有些人认为这种折磨是想要控制受害者的贩子们的典型做法，而另一些人则质疑为什么性贩子会

sentences.en: want to taint their own product.
sentences.zh: 想要毁掉自己的商品。

sentences.en: Based on the description that Sherry had provided of her time in captivity, investigators began working on the theory that she had been held somewhere in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 根据雪莉提供的关于她被囚禁时间的描述，调查人员开始推测她被关在山里的某个地方。

sentences.en: They obtained cell phone data from the area where Sherry was abducted and the area where she was found, on the lookout for any numbers that pinged off phone
sentences.zh: 他们获取了雪莉被绑架地区和被找到地区的手机数据，寻找任何在两个地点的手机

sentences.en: towers at both locations.
sentences.zh: 基站都有信号的号码。

sentences.en: As reported by the Sacramento Bee, six numbers came up.
sentences.zh: 据《萨克拉门托蜂报》报道，出现了六个号码。

sentences.en: Among them was a 21-year-old woman.
sentences.zh: 其中有一个 21 岁的女性。

sentences.en: Police visited her home, discovering that she had dark hair like Sherry's young captor.
sentences.zh: 警方走访了她的家，发现她和雪莉年轻的绑架者一样有着黑发。

sentences.en: But she wasn't Latina and had an alibi for the abduction period.
sentences.zh: 但她不是拉丁裔，并且在绑架期间有不在场证明。

sentences.en: Tip-offs continued to come in from the public.
sentences.zh: 公众的线索仍在源源不断地涌入。

sentences.en: One woman reported having seen a pair of
sentences.zh: 一名女子报告说，她在沃尔玛看到了一对

sentences.en: Latina women who matched the suspect descriptions in a Walmart store.
sentences.zh: 符合嫌疑人特征的拉丁裔女子。

sentences.en: They were looking at her and whispering.
sentences.zh: 她们看着她并窃窃私语。

sentences.en: The caller had blonde hair similar to Sherry
sentences.zh: 报警者的头发是金色的，和雪莉·

sentences.en: Pepini.
sentences.zh: 佩皮尼很像。

sentences.en: She was scared that she might be next.
sentences.zh: 她害怕自己可能会是下一个。

sentences.en: By December 3, Sherry Pepini had been home for a week and a half.
sentences.zh: 到12月3日，雪莉·佩皮尼已经回家一个半星期了。

sentences.en: Hundreds of Reading locals gathered to celebrate her safe return and stand in solidarity with their community.
sentences.zh: 数百名雷丁当地人聚集在一起，庆祝她平安归来，并声援他们的社区。

sentences.en: Wearing pink in Sherry's honour, they posed for a photograph underneath a large pink banner that read,
sentences.zh: 他们穿着粉色衣服向雪莉致敬，在一块写着以下字样的大型粉色横幅下合影：

sentences.en: Welcome Home.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回家。

sentences.en: Despite this warm response, Sherry struggled in the aftermath of her abduction.
sentences.zh: 尽管反响热烈，但雪莉在绑架事件发生后一直在苦苦挣扎。

sentences.en: While her physical injuries eventually healed, the emotional scars remained.
sentences.zh: 虽然她的身体伤势最终愈合了，但情感上的伤痕依然存在。

sentences.en: She became afraid of people, particularly strangers, and wanted Keith by her side at all times.
sentences.zh: 她开始害怕人，尤其是陌生人，并希望基思时刻陪伴在她身边。

sentences.en: Neighbours noted that she rarely left the house and her children hardly ever played out in the yard.
sentences.zh: 邻居们注意到她很少出门，她的孩子们也几乎从不在院子里玩耍。

sentences.en: Sherry began extensive therapy to treat post-traumatic stress disorder and anxiety.
sentences.zh: 雪莉开始接受广泛的治疗，以治疗创伤后应激障碍和焦虑症。

sentences.en: She met with investigators from time to time and officers checked in on the Pepinis weekly.
sentences.zh: 她不时与调查人员会面，警官们每周都会探望佩皮尼一家。

sentences.en: But Sherry's recollection of the events became hazy and she was unable to provide any new insights.
sentences.zh: 但雪莉对事件的回忆变得模糊，她无法提供任何新的见解。

sentences.en: The search for her abductors continued, but police failed to come up with any solid leads.
sentences.zh: 对她绑架者的搜寻仍在继续，但警方未能找到任何实质性的线索。

sentences.en: A year went by with no major breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 一年过去了，没有取得任何重大突破。

sentences.en: To mark the upcoming anniversary, a police artist worked with Sherry to create composite sketches of her two captors, bandanas covering the bottom half of their faces.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念即将到来的周年纪念日，一名警局艺术家与雪莉合作，创作了她两名绑架者的合成素描，他们的脸下半部分都蒙着头巾。

sentences.en: These were released to the public, along with the first detailed account of Sherry's experience in captivity.
sentences.zh: 这些素描公之于众，同时发布的还有雪莉在被囚禁期间经历的第一份详细记录。

sentences.en: Keith Pepini released a statement on his family's behalf, thanking their supporters and requesting
sentences.zh: 基思·佩皮尼代表他的家庭发表了一份声明，感谢支持者并请求

sentences.en: privacy, as his wife continued to heal and they focused on putting their lives back together.
sentences.zh: 给予隐私，因为他的妻子仍在康复中，而他们正专注于重整生活。

sentences.en: But, for all the support, Sherry still had her fair share of critics.
sentences.zh: 但是，尽管得到了所有的支持，雪莉仍然遭到了不少批评。

sentences.en: Following her safe return, an online blog post had surfaced from 2007 that had some people asking questions.
sentences.zh: 在她安全返回后，网上浮现了一篇2007年的博客文章，引发了一些人的质疑。

sentences.en: The post had originally appeared on a white supremacy website called skinheads.com.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章最初出现在一个名为skinheads.com的白人至上主义网站上。

sentences.en: It detailed the author's adolescent years, during which her high school experience suffered because she was, quote,
sentences.zh: 文章详细描述了作者的青春期，期间她的高中生活备受煎熬，因为她，引述如下：

sentences.en: This really irked a group of Latino girls who would constantly rag and attack me.
sentences.zh: 这真的惹恼了一群经常取笑和攻击我的拉丁裔女孩。

sentences.en: The author detailed an incident at one of her volleyball games.
sentences.zh: 作者详细描述了她的一场排球比赛中发生的一起事件。

sentences.en: One of the Latina girls had apparently called her dad a Nazi, which enraged the teen and provoked her to launch an attack.
sentences.zh: 其中一名拉丁裔女孩显然骂她的爸爸是纳粹，这激怒了这名青少年，并促使她发动了攻击。

sentences.en: It took three full-grown men to pull her off.
sentences.zh: 足足花了三个成年男子才把她拉开。

sentences.en: By then, she had broken the nose of one of her tormentors.
sentences.zh: 那时，她已经打断了其中一个折磨她的人的鼻子。

sentences.en: The author used this event to explain why girls shouldn't fight, stating,
sentences.zh: 作者利用这件事来解释为什么女孩不应该打架，并陈述道：

sentences.en: We are just too fragile and break easily.
sentences.zh: 我们实在太脆弱了，很容易受伤。

sentences.en: She spoke proudly of her German heritage, concluding,
sentences.zh: 她自豪地谈到自己的德国血统，并总结道：

sentences.en: Being white is more than just being aware of my skin, but of standing behind skinheads, who are always around, in spirit as well, and having pride for my country.
sentences.zh: 身为白人不仅仅是意识到我的皮肤，更是要支持那些无处不在、精神同在的白人至上主义者，并为我的国家感到骄傲。

sentences.en: The author was credited as Sherry Graff, Sherry Pepini's maiden name.
sentences.zh: 作者署名为雪莉·格拉夫（Sherry Graff），即雪莉·佩皮尼的婚前姓。

sentences.en: An old account on social network site Pinterest also surfaced that was attributed to a user named Sherry Pepini.
sentences.zh: 社交网络网站Pinterest上一个归属于名为雪莉·佩皮尼用户的旧账号也浮出水面。

sentences.en: The user had posted several images with pro-white and racist undertones.
sentences.zh: 该用户发布了几张带有亲白人和种族主义暗示的图片。

sentences.en: Sherry's critics immediately started speculating that she had made up the story of her kidnapping to ignite a race war.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的批评者立即开始猜测，她编造了自己被绑架的故事是为了挑起一场种族战争。

sentences.en: Latinos only made up 10% of Shasta County's population, and since Sherry's kidnapping, the minority group had faced ongoing scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 拉丁裔仅占沙斯塔县人口的10%，自雪莉被绑架以来，这个少数族裔群体一直面临着持续的审查。

sentences.en: According to the Sacramento Bee, local women of Latin American descent were advised not to go out
sentences.zh: 根据《萨克拉门托蜜蜂报》报道，当地有拉丁美洲血统的女性被建议不要

sentences.en: in pairs, avoid driving dark-coloured SUVs, and avoid going out in public unless they had a witness.
sentences.zh: 结伴出行，避免驾驶深色SUV，并且在没有见证人的情况下不要公开露面。

sentences.en: Sherry's loved ones firmly denied the allegations that she had written the blog poSt.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的亲人坚决否认她写过这篇博客文章的指控。

sentences.en: Sherry had been briefly married in 2007.
sentences.zh: 雪莉曾在2007年有过一段短暂的婚姻。

sentences.en: Her ex-husband, with whom she had an amicable divorce, told reporters that Sherry wasn't racist and had a very diverse group of friends.
sentences.zh: 与她和平离婚的前夫告诉记者，雪莉并不种族主义，而且有一群非常多元化的朋友。

sentences.en: He said the blog had been maliciously written by someone who hated Sherry in high school, and that she had unsuccessfully attempted to have it removed at the time.
sentences.zh: 他说这篇博客是高中时讨厌雪莉的人恶意撰写的，她当时曾试图将其删除但未成功。

sentences.en: When questioned by investigators, Sherry described the blog post as awful.
sentences.zh: 当被调查人员质问时，雪莉将这篇博客文章描述为糟糕透顶。

sentences.en: She confirmed that she'd hired a lawyer to try and have it taken down.
sentences.zh: 她证实自己曾雇佣一名律师试图将其撤下。

sentences.en: Investigators looked into the claims that Sherry had written a post herself, but were unable to ascertain its true origin.
sentences.zh: 调查人员调查了雪莉自己写过这篇文章的说法，但未能确定其真正的来源。

sentences.en: Regardless of who wrote it, they confirmed too much time had passed for it to be of any relevance to Sherry's current kidnapping case.
sentences.zh: 无论是谁写的，他们确认时间已经过去太久，与雪莉当前的绑架案没有任何关联。

sentences.en: Police openly acknowledged that there were puzzling details about Sherry's abduction, but stated they had no reason to doubt Sherry's story.
sentences.zh: 警方公开承认，雪莉的绑架案中存在令人困惑的细节，但表示他们没有理由怀疑雪莉的故事。

sentences.en: On the one-year anniversary of the abduction, one of the lead investigators told People magazine,
sentences.zh: 在绑架案发生一周年之际，一名首席调查人员告诉《人物》杂志：

sentences.en: There is no information that would indicate it's not true.
sentences.zh: 没有任何信息表明这不是真的。

sentences.en: I have invested almost a year of my career in this case, and we will continue on until we get some answers, and hopefully get some people in custody soon.
sentences.zh: 我在这个案件上投入了近一年的职业生涯，我们将继续坚持下去，直到我们得到一些答案，并希望很快能将一些人拘留。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案室节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案室节目继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: For investigators behind closed doors, unanswered questions were stacking up.
sentences.zh: 对于闭门调查的调查人员来说，未解的问题正在堆积如山。

sentences.en: For starters, a motive still hadn't been established.
sentences.zh: 首先，动机仍未确定。

sentences.en: Sherry Papini's captors had never demanded a ransom, and there was no conclusive evidence to support the human trafficking theory.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·帕皮尼的绑架者从未索要赎金，也没有确凿的证据支持人口贩卖理论。

sentences.en: So why had this unassuming mother been targeted?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么这个毫不起眼的母亲会成为目标呢？

sentences.en: Her abductors were seemingly part of a wider network, but there had been no other recent crimes that fit the same bill.
sentences.zh: 她的绑架者似乎是一个更大网络的一部分，但最近没有其他符合这种特点的犯罪。

sentences.en: It therefore seemed strange that they hadn't struck again elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们没有在其他地方再次作案似乎很奇怪。

sentences.en: Over time, other small inconsistencies had started to mount.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，其他一些小的矛盾之处开始积聚。

sentences.en: Sherry had told investigators that she had cut her foot during an altercation with her younger captor.
sentences.zh: 雪莉曾告诉调查人员，她在与较年轻的绑架者的争执中割伤了脚。

sentences.en: Yet, there had been no evidence of such a cut when she was first taken to hospital.
sentences.zh: 然而，她最初被送到医院时，并没有这种割伤的证据。

sentences.en: She'd also given conflicting accounts of when the branding had happened, first saying it had happened early on, and then changing her story and saying it happened later.
sentences.zh: 她还对烙印是什么时候发生的给出了相互矛盾的说法，先是说发生在早期，然后又改口说发生在后期。

sentences.en: Sherry had initially told investigators that she was forced to wear an adult diaper, but never mentioned this detail again.
sentences.zh: 雪莉最初告诉调查人员她被迫穿成人纸尿裤，但再也没有提及这个细节。

sentences.en: Sherry said that when she first woke up in captivity, her hands had been tied behind her back with zip ties.
sentences.zh: 雪莉说，当她第一次在囚禁中醒来时，她的双手被扎带反绑在背后。

sentences.en: She explained that she'd managed to chew through the bindings, but had never explained how she managed to get her hands from behind her back.
sentences.zh: 她解释说她设法咬断了束缚，但从未解释她是如何把双手从背后拿出来的。

sentences.en: While investigators knew it was entirely possible that Sherry's memory had been distorted by trauma, the inconsistencies raised some major red flags.
sentences.zh: 虽然调查人员知道雪莉的记忆完全有可能被创伤扭曲，但这些矛盾之处引起了人们的极大警惕。

sentences.en: Perhaps most perplexing was the fact that when Sherry was found safe, her clothing was sent off for DNA testing.
sentences.zh: 也许最令人费解的事实是，当雪莉被安全找到时，她的衣服被送去进行DNA检测。

sentences.en: Traces of unknown male DNA was found on both her underwear and sweatpants, but there was no female DNA.
sentences.zh: 在她的内裤和运动裤上都发现了未知男性DNA的痕迹，但没有女性DNA。

sentences.en: Investigators ran the profile through the National CODIS database, in which DNA profiles from crime scenes and known offenders are stored.
sentences.zh: 调查人员通过国家CODIS数据库运行了该档案，该数据库存储了犯罪现场和已知罪犯的DNA档案。

sentences.en: There were no matches.
sentences.zh: 没有找到匹配项。

sentences.en: But if Sherry had been taken by two women with no one else involved, this didn't explain the DNA discrepancy.
sentences.zh: 但如果雪莉是被两个女人带走且没有其他人参与，这就无法解释DNA的不一致。

sentences.en: Investigators learned early on that Sherry had a history of lying.
sentences.zh: 调查人员很早就得知雪莉有撒谎的历史。

sentences.en: Several of Sherry's friends had described her as a crazy and wild youth who often ran away and made up stories, including that she suffered from a heart condition.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的几个朋友将她描述为一个疯狂而野蛮的年轻人，经常离家出走并编造故事，包括声称自己患有心脏病。

sentences.en: An ex-boyfriend described her as attention-hungry.
sentences.zh: 一个前男友形容她渴望关注。

sentences.en: He said Sherry fabricated stories of being abused by her family and even accused him of abuse once their relationship ended.
sentences.zh: 他说雪莉捏造了被家人虐待的故事，甚至在他们关系结束后指控他虐待。

sentences.en: The director of a youth program that Sherry had once participated in said that Sherry was, quote,
sentences.zh: 雪莉曾参加过的一个青年项目的负责人说，雪莉，引述如下：

sentences.en: good at creating different realities for people so that they would see what she wanted them to see, which got her really good attention.
sentences.zh: 很擅长为人们创造不同的现实，让他们看到她想让他们看到的，这为她赢得了很好的关注。

sentences.en: Sherry's first marriage had been one of convenience.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的第一段婚姻是一场权宜婚姻。

sentences.en: Her first husband was in the military and had agreed to marry Sherry so she could take advantage of his health insurance.
sentences.zh: 她的第一任丈夫在军队，并同意娶雪莉，这样她就可以利用他的健康保险。

sentences.en: While Sherry had told her second husband Keith this was due to a heart murmur, she had told her first husband it was due to complications from regular egg donation.
sentences.zh: 虽然雪莉告诉她的第二任丈夫基思这是因为心脏杂音，但她告诉她的第一任丈夫这是由于定期捐卵的并发症。

sentences.en: Sherry had also told her first husband that her family was abusive.
sentences.zh: 雪莉还告诉她的第一任丈夫她的家庭有虐待倾向。

sentences.en: It was only after their divorce that mutual friends warned him that she had a history of lying.
sentences.zh: 直到他们离婚后，共同的朋友才警告他，她有撒谎的历史。

sentences.en: Investigations conducted by the Sacramento Bee newspaper revealed that in 2003,
sentences.zh: 《萨克拉门托蜜蜂报》进行的调查显示，2003年，

sentences.en: Sherry's mother Loretta had called the local sheriff's department to lodge an incident report.
sentences.zh: 雪莉的母亲洛雷塔曾致电当地治安官办公室提交一份事件报告。

sentences.en: Loretta claimed that her daughter was harming herself and then blaming the injuries on Loretta.
sentences.zh: 洛雷塔声称她的女儿在伤害自己，然后将伤情归咎于洛雷塔。

sentences.en: A deputy had provided Loretta with advice but no further action was taken.
sentences.zh: 一名副警长向洛雷塔提供了建议，但没有采取进一步行动。

sentences.en: This wasn't the only time a member of Sherry's family had reported her to the police.
sentences.zh: 这并不是雪莉的家人第一次向警方举报她。

sentences.en: In 2000, Sherry's father Richard accused her of burglarising his home.
sentences.zh: 2000年，雪莉的父亲理查德指控她入室盗窃他的家。

sentences.en: That same year, Sherry's sister Sheila had her back door vandalised.
sentences.zh: 同年，雪莉的姐姐希拉的后门遭到破坏。

sentences.en: When she reported it to the police, she named Sherry as a suspect.
sentences.zh: 当她向警方报案时，她将雪莉列为嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Three years later,
sentences.zh: 三年后，

sentences.en: Richard alleged that Sherry stole money from his checking account.
sentences.zh: 理查德指控雪莉从他的支票账户中盗取了金钱。

sentences.en: Although investigators had been aware of these issues, it didn't prove that Sherry was lying about her kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 尽管调查人员已经知道了这些问题，但这并不能证明雪莉在绑架一事上撒谎。

sentences.en: The hunt to find her abductors continued, but the years passed by with no arrests.
sentences.zh: 寻找她绑架者的搜寻工作仍在继续，但几年过去了，依然无人被捕。

sentences.en: By 2020, the case had long faded from the headlines, but it hadn't been forgotten by the Reading community, who still wanted answers.
sentences.zh: 到2020年，这个案件早已从头条新闻中淡出，但雷丁社区并没有忘记它，他们仍然想要答案。

sentences.en: Skepticism remained rife, while fears that kidnappers were on the loose continued to haunt locals, some of whom had been too scared to let their young daughters walk alone
sentences.zh: 怀疑态度依然普遍存在，而绑架者在逃的恐惧继续困扰着当地人，其中一些人甚至害怕让他们的年轻女儿独自走路

sentences.en: ever since Sherry's attack.
sentences.zh: 自从雪莉遭到袭击以来。

sentences.en: Sherry continued to work intermittently with the police.
sentences.zh: 雪莉继续断断续续地与警方合作。

sentences.en: Whenever she remembered something new that could help with the investigation, she or her husband would call to make a report.
sentences.zh: 每当她想起可能有助于调查的新情况时，她或她的丈夫就会打电话报案。

sentences.en: Sherry looked online to find photos of anything that shared similarities to details from her abduction, from the hairlines of her kidnappers to the coffee table she was tied to
sentences.zh: 雪莉在网上寻找任何与她的绑架细节相似的物体的照片，从她绑架者的发际线到她被绑在上面的茶几

sentences.en: during her branding.
sentences.zh: 在她被烙印期间。

Sherry and Keith Pepini met with two detectives from the Shasta County Sheriff's Department who had been working the case from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 雪莉和基思·佩皮尼会见了沙斯塔县治安官办公室的两名侦探，他们从一开始就一直在处理这个案件。

sentences.en: They had some photos of potential suspects they wanted to show Sherry.
sentences.zh: 他们有一些想给雪莉看的潜在嫌疑人的照片。

sentences.en: She studied them carefully, looking at them from different angles and honing in on small features.
sentences.zh: 她仔细研究它们，从不同的角度观察并聚焦于微小的特征。

sentences.en: I'm trying not to get my hopes up.
sentences.zh: 我在尽量不抱太大希望。

sentences.zh: 我要说，这正是吸引我注意这张照片的地方。

sentences.en: So on photo number five, this is the first one we showed you, this is the second one we showed you.
sentences.zh: 所以在五号照片上，这是我们向你展示的第一张，这是我们向你展示的第二张。

sentences.en: So on six-pack number two...
sentences.zh: 所以在第二组六张照片上……

sentences.zh: 但就像你说的，如果有人减肥了，那就会改变。

sentences.zh: 你被五号照片吸引了？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 五号照片的特征？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 正确。

sentences.en: And again, just for the record and for when you go back,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，为了记录在案以及你回去的时候，

sentences.en: number one is, when you say three is similar, she's similar to the younger female that we've always described and everything.
sentences.zh: 第一点是，当你3号相似的时候，她和我们一直描述的那个较年轻的女性很像，诸如此类。

sentences.en: This part right here doesn't really match what I'm remembering.
sentences.zh: 这里的这一部分其实和我记忆中的不匹配。

sentences.en: The hairline doesn't match?
sentences.zh: 发际线不匹配？

sentences.en: Smaller one, older one.
sentences.zh: 较小的那个，较大的那个。

sentences.en: And just because it's been a long time,
sentences.zh: 而且就因为时间过去很久了，

sentences.en: can you remind me what number, what the younger one did, like the main parts of it compared to the older one just for the last, like clarity and stuff?
sentences.zh: 你能提醒我一下哪个数字，较年轻的那个做了什么，比如与较大的那个相比的主要部分，只是为了最后，比如弄清楚之类的？

sentences.en: So for the record, so...
sentences.zh: 所以为了记录在案，所以……

sentences.en: The younger one's the one that let me go and was the nicer of the two.
sentences.zh: 较年轻的那个是放我走的人，也是两者中比较好的那个。

sentences.en: The older one was really abusive and really mean and is the one that did all the really terrible things.
sentences.zh: 较大的那个真的很虐待人，真的很刻薄，而且做了所有那些真正糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.zh: 然后侦探们向

sentences.zh: 雪莉展示了一些与她描述过的类似的茶几照片。

sentences.en: Focusing on one of them,
sentences.zh: 聚焦其中一张，

sentences.en: Sherry enthusiastically exclaimed,
sentences.zh: 雪莉热情地惊呼道：

sentences.en: Excuse my language, but it's pretty fucking similar.
sentences.zh: 请原谅我的粗口，但这他妈的太像了。

sentences.en: You said it looks very similar.
sentences.zh: 你说它看起来非常相似。

sentences.zh: 哪里相似？

sentences.zh: 我是说，这是……

sentences.en: What I'm remembering that feeling, you know, grabbing it and feeling that feeling.
sentences.zh: 我记忆中的那种感觉，你知道，抓着它，感受那种感觉。

sentences.en: But this part is different.
sentences.zh: 但这一部分是不同的。

sentences.en: This part is different.
sentences.zh: 这一部分是不同的。

sentences.en: That doesn't definitely...
sentences.zh: 那绝对……

sentences.en: So you're saying this metal part, it looks the same as what you remember.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说这个金属部分，它看起来和你记忆中的一样。

sentences.en: But this piece right here...
sentences.zh: 但这一块……

sentences.en: This part doesn't look the same.
sentences.zh: 这部分看起来不一样。

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 它有什么不同？

sentences.zh: 那个要多得多。

sentences.zh: 那里的东西还要多得多。

sentences.zh: 比如，更厚重的？

sentences.zh: 对，谢谢你。

sentences.zh: 我觉得照片并没有真正拍出……

sentences.en: Sherry had always described her captor's bathroom as having a unique layout.
sentences.zh: 雪莉一直形容绑架她的人的浴室布局很独特。

sentences.en: The detectives showed her some photos of bathrooms with similar designs to the ones she'd described.
sentences.zh: 侦探们给她看了一些浴室的照片，其设计与她描述的相似。

sentences.en: Sherry acknowledged the layouts were similar, but that was all.
sentences.zh: 雪莉承认布局确实相似，但也仅此而已。

sentences.en: She'd previously said there was a crack in the shower tile.
sentences.zh: 她之前说过淋浴瓷砖上有道裂缝。

sentences.en: Shown a photo of a shower with a crack in it,
sentences.zh: 当看到一张带有裂缝的淋浴间照片时，

sentences.en: Sherry couldn't say whether it was the same one.
sentences.zh: 雪莉无法确定这是否是同一个。

sentences.en: After all these years, she was struggling to remember.
sentences.zh: 这么多年过去了，她很难想起来。

sentences.en: The detectives made it clear they weren't trying to overwhelm Sherry.
sentences.zh: 侦探们明确表示他们并不是想给雪莉太大压力。

sentences.en: There was actually a good reason for the probing.
sentences.zh: 盘问其实是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: They had found the house that Sherry was held in, and they knew who was responsible.
sentences.zh: 他们已经找到了关押雪莉的房子，并且知道谁是罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: Keith Pepini was elated.
sentences.zh: 基思·佩皮尼欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: He pumped his fists in the air and rubbed his hands together in glee.
sentences.zh: 他兴奋地挥舞着双拳，双十相搓，喜形于色。

sentences.en: But Sherry's reaction was surprising.
sentences.zh: 但雪莉的反应却出人意料。

sentences.en: She became strangely defensive.
sentences.zh: 她变得异常防备。

sentences.en: Over the years, investigators had continued to run checks on the DNA found on Sherry's clothing in case someone new had entered the CODIS database during that time.
sentences.zh: 多年来，调查人员一直在对雪莉衣服上发现的DNA进行比对筛查，以防期间有新人进入CODIS数据库。

sentences.en: No matches were ever made.
sentences.zh: 从未有过匹配结果。

sentences.en: Then came the rise of genealogy testing where users voluntarily submitted DNA to trace their family trees.
sentences.zh: 随后，谱系检测兴起，用户自愿提交DNA来追溯家族谱系。

sentences.en: In 2018, familial DNA had led to the apprehension of the notorious
sentences.zh: 2018年，家族DNA技术协助抓获了臭名昭著的

sentences.en: Golden State Killer, as covered in episode 53 of Case File.
sentences.zh: 金州杀手，正如《档案》第53期所报道的那样。

sentences.en: Investigators wondered whether the same technique could be applied to identify
sentences.zh: 调查人员想知道是否可以将同样的技术应用于识别

sentences.en: Sherry Pepini's captors.
sentences.zh: 雪莉·佩皮尼的绑架者。

sentences.en: In March 2020, they ran the DNA from Sherry's clothing through an Ancestry DNA database.
sentences.zh: 2020年3月，他们将雪莉衣服上的DNA输入了祖源DNA数据库。

sentences.en: This time, there was a match.
sentences.zh: 这一次，有了匹配结果。

sentences.zh: 数据库中的DNA属于一个育有两个亲生儿子的男子。
